# Windsor HVAC Pro

> Windsor HVAC Pro is a local HVAC company serving Windsor, Essex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 800-4143  |  Email: contact@windsorhvacpro.ca  |  Website: https://windsorhvacpro.ca

Service areas: Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
